core_settings.name: core_attributes.sensor_id
core_settings.label: Managing sensor
core_settings.description: Sensor that runs the integration against the FortiWeb appliance.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.host
config_settings.label: FortiWeb host (FQDN or IP)
config_settings.description: Management address of the FortiWeb appliance, without scheme or port (e.g. fortiweb.example.com).

config_settings.name: config_attributes.port
config_settings.label: FortiWeb REST API port
config_settings.description: HTTPS port of the FortiWeb management interface / REST API. Defaults to 443 when left blank.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.userName
config_settings.label: FortiWeb username
config_settings.description: FortiWeb administrator account with REST API access to certificates and server policies.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.authentication_method
config_settings.label: authentication_method
config_settings.description: How the FortiWeb password is supplied: typed directly into TLM, or resolved at runtime from an external Secrets Manager (PAM) connector.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.password
config_settings.label: FortiWeb password
config_settings.description: Password of the FortiWeb administrator account.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.pam_connector_id
config_settings.label: secrets_manager_connector
config_settings.description: Registered Secrets Manager (PAM) connector that resolves the FortiWeb password at runtime.

conditional_banners.title: Note
conditional_banners.description: Use the format systemName slash accountName to reference the FortiWeb password from BeyondTrust vaults

conditional_banners.title: Note
conditional_banners.description: Use the object or secret name to reference the FortiWeb password from CyberArk vaults

conditional_banners.title: Note
conditional_banners.description: Use the numeric secret id optionally followed by slash field slug to reference the FortiWeb password from Delinea secrets

config_settings.name: config_attributes.password
config_settings.label: FortiWeb password (PAM vault reference)
config_settings.description: Enter the PAM vault reference that holds the FortiWeb password, not the password itself. BeyondTrust: SystemName/AccountName. CyberArk: object name. Delinea: secretId or secretId/fieldSlug.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.vdom
config_settings.label: FortiWeb ADOM
config_settings.description: Administrative domain the account logs in to (sent as 'vdom' in the API token). Leave blank for 'root'.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.sshPort
config_settings.label: FortiWeb SSH port (certificate discovery)
config_settings.description: SSH port of the management interface (default 22). The plugin logs in with the same username/password and runs the read-only CLI command 'show system certificate local' to read certificate bodies, which the REST API does not return. Enter 0 to disable SSH (discovered certificates then show metadata only and cannot be selected in TLM).

config_settings.name: config_attributes.keepReplacedCertificate
config_settings.label: Keep the replaced certificate on FortiWeb after rotation
config_settings.description: By default the previous certificate is deleted once every server policy / SNI member / multi-cert group has been repointed to the new one and FortiWeb reports it as unreferenced. Tick to leave it in place for manual clean-up.
